investigations.name: biomodels-cross-simulator-validation
investigations.title: Cross-simulator validation of BioModels
investigations.question: Do independent SBML simulators reproduce curated BioModels, and how well do they agree with each other and with the BioSimulators reference results?
investigations.hypothesis: For well-posed BioModels, COPASI, Tellurium and simbio agree with the BioSimulators references within a small nRMSE; divergences localize to stiff or ill-scaled models and expose engine-specific tolerance sensitivity.
